name: arandevcode-mods
description: Claude Code mods by arandevcode: thinking glow, quota panel and hex color swatches.

plugins.name: glow-thinking
plugins.description: Status band above the prompt and gradient border around every side panel: WORKING (rainbow) while the turn or any subagent runs, WAITING (amber) for monitors and background tasks, IDLE (green) when done. /thinking shows time per model.

plugins.name: quota-panel
plugins.description: Side panel with your Claude rate-limit windows (5h / weekly): bars, % left, reset time and pace, plus session cost and toasts at 80/90/95%.

plugins.name: hex-swatch
plugins.description: Shows a color square next to every hex color (#rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa) in Claude's replies: text, tables, lists and code blocks. Works alone and together with a skin.
